name: WebRTC
description: Real-time audio, video and data between peers: the W3C WebRTC API (RTCPeerConnection, MediaStream, RTCDataChannel, getUserMedia) over libwebrtc on iOS and Android and the browser's stack on the web, plus RTCVideoView to draw a track. Signaling is the app's; an SFU client can run over it.

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: The app uses the camera for video calls.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: The app uses the microphone for calls.
